label: EXPLORATORY: Stage 1 deployment-check channel (plan section 4.3), computed outside the gate on saved gate actors; no training; not a gated output; changes no pre-registered rule; no BCA band, calibrator, threshold, dose or BCA update was used (stand-ins and oracles only)
launch_condition_text: Launched after the room test's pooled look passed its room, recovery and keeps-improvement marks (room pooled.json SHA-256 dde4ac9ff4da3f31bd92784cc5ffde0e99d4103f61f7a5bc1eb8f1e7c74a97c1).

mark.rule: 'The channel is open' iff, on the gapped critic's actor in the stalling world with the clip fallback, pooled over seeds 0-4 (mean of the per-seed paired differences, every seed present): (i) points(perfect detector -> clip) - points(random at its own rate -> clip) >= 15 in strong current or in big kicks, and (ii) points(actor alone) - points(perfect detector -> clip) <= 3 in recorded conditions
